newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE Ecu futures main movers.
newsitem.headline: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE Ecu futures main movers.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed easier against the dollar in what traders described as a quiet day on the interbank forex market.
"The small changes were due to fluctuations of the dollar/mark cross," said Noemi Koppendorfer of Magyar Hitel Bank.
The forint closed at 153.62/67 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 153.50/55.
The forint floats against a basket of currencies made up 70 percent of the Ecu and 30 percent of the dollar.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), dollar futures accounted for 912 million forints of the total 2.13 billion forints turnover.
Ecu futures were the main movers, dropping for four maturities and rising for two. Mark and yen futures finished mostly lower, while the dollar ended mixed.
